//: Type-checks `worker/index.ts`. Nothing here emits — wrangler bundles the worker with
esbuild, which strips types WITHOUT checking them, so without this config a typo like
`env.ASSSETS` compiles happily and only fails in production as a 500.
`types` is scoped to the Workers runtime globals (Fetcher, ExportedHandler, caches, …)
instead of pulling in DOM, which the worker does not have.
